results.title: Getting Started | Vitest
results.snippet: Vitest is a Vite-native testing framework. It is fast by design, leveraging Vite's transformation pipeline. Startup time is typically under 200ms.

results.title: vitest - npm
results.snippet: Vitest has 15M+ weekly downloads and growing rapidly. Compatible with Jest API for easy migration.

results.title: vitest-dev/vitest: Next generation testing framework - GitHub
results.snippet: Vitest is a blazing fast unit test framework powered by Vite. 13k stars. Maintained by the Vue/Vite core team.

results.title: Vitest startup is 10x faster than Jest — benchmarks
results.snippet: In controlled benchmarks, Vitest cold start clocks at ~120ms versus Jest's ~800ms. Hot reload in watch mode is nearly instant.
